title: Luggage re-identification: A study of strategies towards a real-world application
abstract: arXiv:2610.40643v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Luggage re-identification (ReID) is a critical task in video surveillance for forensics, security or border management (suspicious or abandoned luggage recognition), as well as luggage management (lost luggage recovery). It enables the association of observations of the same luggage across disjoint camera views in complex environments such as airports, train stations and border crossing. While existing approaches primarily focus on appearance-based cropped image matching under relatively clean conditions, real-world scenarios are characterized by frequent occlusions, cluttered background and crowded scenes which significantly degrade performance. Yet, strategies leveraging the complementarity of multiple shots and views from different video streams is overlooked. translated_title: 行李再识别：面向真实应用场景的策略研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.40643v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：行李再识别是视频监控中的一项关键任务，可用于法证分析、安全或边境管理（如可疑或被遗弃行李的识别），以及行李管理（如丢失行李的找回）。该任务能够在机场、火车站和边境口岸等复杂环境中，跨不相交的摄像头视图关联同一行李的观测结果。现有方法主要集中于在相对干净的条件下基于外观的裁剪图像匹配，而真实场景中普遍存在频繁遮挡、杂乱背景和拥挤人群，这些因素会显著降低系统性能。然而，利用来自不同视频流的多个镜头和多个视图之间互补性的策略却一直被忽视。在本文中，我们研究了从多个视频流中检测并再识别行李的端到端流水线的各种策略，并在一个……上评估了不同的变体（原文摘要至此被截断）。
tldr: 该论文针对真实场景中频繁遮挡、杂乱背景和拥挤环境导致性能下降的问题，提出了利用来自不同视频流的多镜头与多视图互补性的端到端行李检测与再识别流水线策略，以实现真实世界的行李再识别应用。
en_tdlr: This paper studies strategies for an end-to-end pipeline that detects and re-identifies luggage from multiple video streams, leveraging the complementarity of multiple shots and views to overcome occlusions, cluttered backgrounds, and crowded scenes in real-world surveillance applications.
